# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## I. By Primary Task Type

### A. Loop/Path Drawing
Puzzles where the solver draws a single continuous loop or path through the grid.

#### A1. Pure Loop Construction
- **Masyu** – Loop through cells, constrained by black/white circle rules
- **Slitherlink** – Loop on grid edges/dots, constrained by number clues
- **Mid-loop** – Loop through cells, black circles must be midpoints of straight segments
- **Nagareru** – Directed loop with wind constraints
- **Moon-or-Sun** – Loop through rooms, alternating between moon/sun symbols
- **Suraromu** – Loop starting/ending at numbered circle, passing through gates in order
- **Dotchi-Loop** – Loop through cells, with straight/turn constraints per region on white circles; avoids black circles

#### A2. Loop with Shading
- **Yajilin** – Loop plus placement of black cells, with directional number clues

#### A3. Path/Connection Drawing
- **Numberlink** – Connect pairs of identical numbers with non-crossing paths
- **Hashiwokakero** – Connect island nodes with bridges (1 or 2), forming a connected network

---

### B. Cell Shading/Painting
Puzzles where the solver colors certain cells black (or leaves them white).

#### B1. Shading with Number Clues (counting adjacent/nearby black cells)
- **Kurotto** – Numbers in circles indicate sum of contiguous black cell groups touching them
- **Nurikabe** – Numbers indicate size of white islands; black cells form one connected wall with no 2×2
- **Kurodoko** – Numbers indicate count of visible white cells in four directions
- **Akari** – Place light bulbs that illuminate rows/columns; numbered black cells constrain adjacent bulb count

#### B2. Shading with Regional Constraints
- **Heyawake** – Rooms with number clues for black cell count; connectivity and continuity rules
- **Norinori** – Exactly two black cells per region, each black cell part of a domino
- **Nurimisaki** – Shading with promontory (dead-end) constraints on circled cells; no 2×2 of either color
- **Nurimeizu** – Shade entire rooms to create a maze from S to G; shortest path constraints
- **Nuritwin** – Each region has exactly two same-sized shaded blocks; all shading connected; no 2×2
- **LITS** – Place one tetromino per region; connected shading; no 2×2; no same-shape adjacency
- **Sto-stone** – Shade cells in rooms so that "dropped" stones fill bottom half of grid
- **Usowan** – Numbers indicate adjacent black cells, but one number per room is a liar
- **Tilepaint** – Shade entire tiles; diagonal clue cells give row/column black cell counts

#### B3. Shading to Form Geometric Shapes
- **Choco Banana** – Black groups must be rectangles; white groups must not be rectangles; number clues for area
- **Shakashaka** – Place triangles so remaining white space forms rectangles/squares

#### B4. Shading with Uniqueness/Elimination
- **Hitori** – Shade duplicate numbers so no repeats in rows/columns; no adjacent black cells; white cells connected

---

### C. Region Division/Partitioning
Puzzles where the solver divides the grid into regions or blocks.

#### C1. Division into Specified Shapes
- **Shikaku** – Divide into rectangles, each containing exactly one number equal to its area
- **Five Cells** – Divide into pentominoes; number clues count surrounding block edges
- **Sashigane** – Divide into L-shaped blocks; circles mark bends; arrows mark ends

#### C2. Division with Matching/Pairing Constraints
- **Double Choco** – Divide into blocks where white and gray portions have identical shape

#### C3. Division with Number-Fill
- **Fillomino** – Fill numbers and implicitly partition into polyominoes; each block's size equals its number; same-size blocks cannot be adjacent
- **Makaro** – Fill rooms with 1-to-N; arrow cells point to the largest neighbor; no same number across room borders
- **Ripple Effect** – Fill rooms with 1-to-N; separation constraint on repeated numbers in rows/columns

---

### D. Number/Symbol Placement
Puzzles where the solver fills cells with numbers or symbols.

#### D1. Latin Square Variants
- **Sudoku** – Place 1–9 in rows, columns, and 3×3 boxes without repetition

#### D2. Number Placement from a List
- **Nansuke** – Fill blank cells with digits to form given multi-digit numbers from a word list

#### D3. Symbol Placement
- **Juosan** – Fill every cell with — or |; territory clues for majority symbol; extension limits on consecutive same symbols

#### D4. Sequential/Positional Placement
- **Hebi** – Place snakes (sequences 1–5) with adjacency, visibility, and directional attack constraints

---

### E. Object Placement/Movement

#### E1. Placement of Objects
- **Akari** – Place light bulbs in white cells (also fits B1 above)
- **Evolomino** – Place growing polyomino blocks along arrow paths
- **Pencils** – Identify pencil shapes and draw lines from their tips
- **Chained Block** – Determine which cells are black to form blocks with size numbers; blocks chain at corners with shape uniqueness

#### E2. Movement of Objects
- **Satogaeri** – Move circles within countries so each country has exactly one; movement distance clues; no crossing paths
- **Yosenabe** – Move circles into gray areas via straight arrows; sum constraints on gray areas

---

## II. By Constraint Mechanism

### Connectivity Constraints
All white cells connected: **Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurimisaki, Heyawake, Nurikabe, Nurimeizu**
All black/shaded cells connected: **Nurikabe, LITS, Nuritwin**
Single loop (no branching/crossing): **Masyu, Slitherlink, Mid-loop, Nagareru, Moon-or-Sun, Suraromu, Dotchi-Loop, Yajilin**
Connected bridge network: **Hashiwokakero**

### No 2×2 Constraint
No 2×2 black: **Nurikabe, LITS, Nuritwin, Sto-stone**
No 2×2 of either color: **Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu**

### Adjacency/Touching Prohibition
Black cells cannot touch orthogonally: **Hitori, Kurodoko, Yajilin, Heyawake, Usowan**
Same-shape pieces cannot touch: **LITS**
Snakes cannot touch: **Hebi**

### Regional/Room Constraints
Rooms with number clues: **Heyawake, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Sto-stone, Moon-or-Sun, Nurimeizu, Double Choco, Usowan, Norinori, Nuritwin**

### Directional/Arrow Clues
**Yajilin, Makaro, Hebi, Nagareru, Sashigane, Evolomino, Yosenabe**

### Visibility/Line-of-Sight Clues
**Akari, Kurodoko, Hebi**

---

## III. By Grid Element Used

| Grid Element | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **Numbered black cells** | Akari, Yajilin, Hebi, Shakashaka |
| **Circled numbers** | Kurodoko, Kurotto, Hashiwokakero, Nurimisaki, Satogaeri, Suraromu, Yosenabe |
| **Black/white circles (no numbers)** | Masyu, Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop |
| **Bold-line rooms/regions** | Heyawake, Norinori, Double Choco, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Moon-or-Sun, Nurimeizu, Nuritwin, Usowan, Suraromu, Tilepaint, Sto-stone |
| **Arrows** | Makaro, Hebi, Sashigane, Evolomino, Nagareru, Yajilin |
| **Dots on grid intersections** | Slitherlink |
| **Moon/Sun symbols** | Moon-or-Sun |
| **Pre-filled numbers** | Sudoku, Hitori, Fillomino, Nansuke, Five Cells, Shikaku |
| **Gray/white cell coloring (given)** | Double Choco, Sto-stone |
| **Diagonal clue cells** | Tilepaint |
| **Gates (dotted lines)** | Suraromu |
| **Question marks** | Chained Block |
